ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an early‑Dead psychedelic set with a soaring Dark Star and solid Morning Dew, though the performance is uneven in places.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers clear, well‑separated sound that lets the band’s 1969 improvisations shine, especially on Dark Star, Morning Dew and St. Stephen. While most reviewers praise the musical moments, a few note occasional tempo hiccups (e.g., The Eleven) and that this version is slightly less complete than other archives. Overall the show is regarded as a classic early‑Dead performance with good‑to‑excellent audio fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is solid but not uniformly outstanding; recording quality is generally praised as clear and well balanced, leading to an overall rating around four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp mix with excellent instrument separation and a live feel; no major drop‑outs, though some listeners note slight pitch variance compared to official releases.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical early‑'69 psychedelic set with a strong middle portion; the band builds nicely into Dark Star and maintains energy through Morning Dew, but occasional rhythmic looseness (e.g., The Eleven) makes the flow uneven at times.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his soaring guitar tone and memorable improvisational licks.
